description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5310014561576 NUT,SELF-LOCKING,EX: Line 0001 Qty 1471 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0146 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). Quotes must be submitted electronically.
